verdict.rationale: Dagster models dbt projects as assets (dagster-docs-7) and represents loaders like Fivetran, dlt and Airbyte as assets that chain with downstream steps (dagster-docs-21, dagster-docs-22, dagster-docs-28). Declarative Automation launches runs based on upstream asset status, and on_cron only fires after all upstream dependencies have updated (dagster-docs-6, dagster-docs-38), so transformations follow fresh loads rather than a blind timer. A community user reports the Dagster + dbt stack works well together (dagster-comm-9). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that dbt sources are automatically wired as downstream dependencies of ingestion assets, and hands-on corroboration of load-triggered dbt runs specifically.
